name: Pelerin
description: Passeur des confins connaissant les raccourcis permettant de contourner les zones de combat les plus dangereuses.

loadout.armor_outfit: Heavily patched obsolete mining space suit with asymmetrical armor plates welded from salvaged cargo container metal and old warning signs, thick layers of corroded duct tape reinforcing fractured helmet seal and joint connections, exposed pressurized tubes and sparking cables running across chest cavity, industrial fall arrest harness covered in tool pouches, carabiners and coiled rope, rusted knee and elbow pads scavenged from scrapped EVA suits, patched rubber gloves with exposed fingertips stained with grease and burn marks
loadout.arsenal: Militarized mining harpoon rifle with exposed copper induction coils for improvised electromagnetic discharge, jury-rigged battery pack directly taped to weapon stock with frayed wires, circular saw blade attachment integrated into forearm gauntlet, plasma cutting torch holstered at hip with visible fuel lines, heavy industrial bolt pistol strapped to thigh

attitude.behavior: Frontline combatant fully committed to engagement with weapon raised and sighted on approaching threat, weighted combat stance with legs braced wide, body coiled and tensed like compressed spring primed for explosive forward momentum, free hand gripping additional equipment at harness ready for rapid tool swap
attitude.emotion: Intense predatory focus visible through scratched opaque welding visor, jaw clenched tight beneath face mask with grease paint war marks, cold determination mixed with adrenaline-fueled readiness, scarred hands gripping weapon with practiced certainty

palette_names.name: Oxidized Steel Gray
palette_names.role: Primary armor and environmental base tones

palette_names.name: Rust Orange
palette_names.role: Weathered metal, corroded surfaces, and warmth accent

palette_names.name: Hot Blue Plasma
palette_names.role: Energy weapon glow, impact flashes, and light source accent

palette_names.name: Engine Grease Black
palette_names.role: Face paint, staining, and deep shadow

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Cinematic mixed source with dominant blue plasma reflections from weapon impacts, secondary warm orange sparks from debris, volumetric smoke illumination from distant explosions, harsh directional rim lighting cutting through thick particulate atmosphere
color_and_light.mood: Chaotic desperation, violent tension, gritty survival intensity

camera.angle: Low angle dutch tilt to emphasize aggressive forward momentum and threat hierarchy

scenography.setting: Asteroid waystation crossroads junction chamber with corrugated metal walls scarred by plasma impacts, hastily welded barricades constructed from cargo pallets and debris, exposed structural beams and tangled cable conduits overhead, emergency lighting flickering with damaged power grid, thick acrid smoke rolling across floor level obscuring distant figures
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Active plasma round impacts causing violent metal debris explosions and brilliant spark showers, dense layered smoke from burning equipment and hull breaches, floating micro-debris in zero gravity creating suspended dust particles, distant muzzle flashes illuminating enemy silhouettes, screen-space distortion from heat shimmer near plasma weapons
